title: Rainwater and the Season
prompt: Describe the significance of rainwater in early spring.
hint: Think about how rainwater affects nature and people during this time.
sample: Rainwater arrives around February 19th, turning snow into rain and helping crops grow.

title: The Gentle Power of Rain
prompt: Explain how rainwater is described as gentle yet powerful in the poem.
hint: Consider the imagery of rain sneaking in quietly and nourishing everything.
sample: The rain sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing the earth and helping rivers flow again.

ja.sample: 雨は夜風とともに忍び寄り、静かに大地を潤し、川の流れを再び始めさせます。
